description: This PHP source file defines a REST API endpoint class TimesheetCommentAPI for managing comments on timesheet entries in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for updating and retrieving timesheet comments, validation rules, and access control logic.

classes.name: TimesheetCommentAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing timesheet comments, including updating and retrieving comments, with validation and access control.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating or adding a comment to a specific timesheet entry.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific timesheet comment by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented, intended for deleting a comment.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne method.

methods.name: setCommentToTimesheetItem
methods.description: Assigns the comment from request parameters to a TimesheetItem entity.

methods.name: checkAuthorityAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to the specified timesheet.
